import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse
b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
def get(p):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(b+p,timeout=5) as f:return json.load(f)
o=get('/api/operator-lifecycle'); w=get('/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0')['config']
if o['queuePaused'] is not True or w['mode']!='off' or w['enabled'] is not False or w['allowAutonomousSend'] is not False:raise RuntimeError('not_paused')
c=next(x for x in get('/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=0')['chats'] if x['name']=='Media')
p='/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats/'+urllib.parse.quote(c['id'],safe='')
pre=get(p+'/wake-preview')
if pre['state']!='READY_FOR_EXPLICIT_TAB_WAKE' or pre['exactTargetCount']!=1 or pre['chatName']!='Media':raise RuntimeError('unsafe_target')
req=urllib.request.Request(b+p+'/wake',data=json.dumps({'confirm':'WAKE_EXISTING_TAB_ONLY','expectedTargetId':pre['exactTargetId']}).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=16) as f:res=json.load(f)
print(json.dumps({k:res.get(k) for k in ('state','pageResponds','navigationPerformed','reloadPerformed','tabCreated','tabClosed','promptSent','queueResumed')},ensure_ascii=True))

note: Owner-approved existing Media tab guarded one-time foreground wake. Fresh preview/paused checks; no reload, agent resume, or Send. Do not replay unknown.
